query:
MATCH (u:User)-[:HasProfileArtifact]->(a:ProfileArtifact)-[fo:FoundOn]->(c:Computer)
RETURN c.name AS Computer, count(DISTINCT u) AS Users, count(DISTINCT a.artifacttype) AS ArtifactTypes, count(DISTINCT a) AS ArtifactNodes, coalesce(sum(fo.findingcount), 0) AS Findings, coalesce(sum(fo.matchcount), 0) AS Matches
ORDER BY Findings DESC, ArtifactNodes DESC, Users DESC
name: Profilehound - Computers Ranked by Artifact Density
description: Ranks computers by artifact evidence density using FoundOn edge counts.
